description: This file defines HTTP handlers and utilities for managing debug flags in the Kubernetes API server, including registration, listing, and setting string flags.

classes.name: DebugFlags
classes.description: A struct providing handlers for debug flag management under /debug/flags.

classes.name: debugFlag
classes.description: A struct representing a debug flag with its name.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Registers handlers for debug flags at specified URL paths.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Handles requests to list available debug flags as an HTML page.

methods.name: addFlag
methods.description: Adds a new flag to the registered flags map with thread safety.

methods.name: StringFlagPutHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler to set string flags via PUT requests.

methods.name: writePlainText
methods.description: Sends a plain text HTTP response with specified status code.
